categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/interfaces/chain.h and src/node/interfaces.cpp under the IPC label to harden interfaces::Chain against IPC crashes.
categories.rationale: Prevents bitcoin-node crashes and scheduler thread termination caused by invalid IPC parameters or disconnected client notification handlers. The description notes that uncaught ipc::Exception instances on the validation interface scheduler thread terminate the node process, directly addressing IPC crash and disconnect reliability required by #29409.
